page.layout: One page of text, with one marginal note in the right margin. Running head at the top, page number at the top right, catchword at the foot right.

main_text.p: Propositio. Videri injuria negasse vineam Regi.
Ratio 1. quia vinea jure ad Regem spectabat.
Addatur maior: Suum juste petitur: & injuste negatur.
Probetur minor: ex jure regio. 1. Sam. 8.14. Hoc erit ius regis: Tollet agros vestros.ver.17. Eritis ei servi.
Licet autem Domino ad se transferre posses-siones, quibus fruuntur servi.
Ratio II. quia honesto regis desiderio non satisfacere injustum fuit: ex dicto: Cui honorem, honorem.:
Probetur honestas. 1. à forma petitionis: non vi sed honesta permutatione vel emtione eam habere cupit:
II. à fine: Ad honestam recreationem.
Amplificetur ex officio subditorum erga magistratus à Thesi[?]: Partem gratitudinis & honoris Magistratibus debiti esse, illorum commodis & recreationib. honestis privatam utilitatem post-ponere.
Ratio III. Quia duriore responso conciliavit sibi necem contra præceptum: non occides.
Resp. 1. Salvo jure regio. Ostendatur ex regu-la: Lex posterior derogat priori: specialis gene-rali:
II. Extra casum periculi vitæ quod hic erat.
Probetur distinctio ex regula: Ceremonialia & Forensia cedunt moralibus: Et: misericordiam volo non sacrificium.

page.notes: Ornamental mark before "Addatur" and "Amplificetur" omitted (not text). "Thesi" uncertain: the printed word reads like "1 hefi", read as Thesi[?]. Ratio and Roman numerals "II" and "III" are printed as "1 1" and "I I I" and are read as II and III. "Lev.25. 34." is the marginal reference; its position is beside the Obiectio line. Printed word-break "posses-siones" and "inju-ste" were resolved with plain s. Italic run in the last paragraph and the "honorem,_" continuation mark dropped.
